name: Update MS Learn Dates
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/update-mslearn-dates.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/update-mslearn-dates.yml'

jobs:
  validate-bicep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Bicep
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y azure-bicep
          
      - name: Validate Bicep files
        run: |
          find . -name "*.bicep" -exec bicep build {} \;
          
  build-and-package:
    needs: validate-bicep
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: pwsh/actions/setup-powershell@v1
        
      - name: Build Toolkit
        run: |
          .\src\Build-Toolkit.ps1
          
      - name: Package Toolkit
        run: |
          .\src\Package-Toolkit.ps1
          
      - name: Verify metadata files
        run: |
          if (Test-Path "src\package-manifest.json") {
            Write-Host "package-manifest.json exists"
          } else {
            throw "package-manifest.json not found"
          }
          
          $manifest = Get-Content "src\package-manifest.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
          $hasMetadataFiles = $manifest.files | Where-Object { $_.path -like "*metadata.bicep" }
          if ($hasMetadataFiles) {
            Write-Host "Metadata files found in manifest"
          } else {
            throw "No metadata.bicep files found in manifest"
          }
          
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: toolkit-build
          path: |
            src\*.zip
            src\package-manifest.json
            
  test-deployment:
    needs: build-and-package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: toolkit-build
          path: ./build
          
      - name: Setup Azure CLI
        uses: azure/cli@v1
        with:
          inlineScript: echo "Azure CLI setup complete"
          azcliversion: latest
          
      - name: Test deployment
        run: |
          # This would be replaced with actual deployment testing
          echo "Testing deployment with updated metadata contracts..."
          echo "Verifying inter-app contracts are properly defined..."
          
  validate-contracts:
    needs: test-deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Validate metadata contracts
        run: |
          # Check that all apps have metadata.bicep files
          apps=("Core" "Analytics" "Exports" "ManagedExports")
          for app in "${apps[@]}"; do
            if [ -f "src/$app/metadata.bicep" ]; then
              echo "✓ $app/metadata.bicep exists"
            else
              echo "✗ $app/metadata.bicep missing"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          # Validate Bicep build for metadata files
          for app in "${apps[@]}"; do
            if bicep build "src/$app/metadata.bicep"; then
              echo "✓ $app/metadata.bicep builds successfully"
            else
              echo "✗ $app/metadata.bicep failed to build"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          echo "All metadata contracts validated successfully"
